abstract: Manages transit intake staging, vehicular parking capacity, and ambulatory evacuee processing flows
system_message:
You are Evacuation logistics director (LOG). The evacuation logistics director (LOG) manages transit intake staging, vehicular parking capacity, ambulatory evacuee processing flows, and emergency fleet maintenance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency fleet maintenance（FLEET）
information_points.content:
LOG-FLEET-6K6：Emergency fleet maintenance records for Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex reflect a dedicated shuttle reserve count of 18 vehicles.
LOG-FLEET-0EU：Pinewood Regional Expo Center maintains a dedicated shuttle reserve count of 30 vehicles inspected and fueled on standby.
LOG-FLEET-GQ1：The standby municipal transport inventory for Bayou Vista Community College Campus shows a dedicated shuttle reserve count of 24 vehicles.

information_points.title: Manages transit intake staging, vehicular parking capacity, and ambulatory evacuee processing flows（TRANS）
information_points.content:
LOG-TRANS-VP9：For Pinewood Regional Expo Center, the traffic circulation survey confirms a heavy vehicle staging capacity of 12 bays along the designated perimeter concourse, while registration simulations establish a processed ambulatory evacuee capacity of 3,500 evacuees/d across non-acute intake concourses.
LOG-TRANS-HZG：Bayou Vista Community College Campus provides a heavy vehicle staging capacity of 8 bays for simultaneous motorcoach unloading, alongside a processed ambulatory evacuee capacity of 5,500 evacuees/d per 24-hour cycle.
LOG-TRANS-BL4：At Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex, perimeter loading concourses support a heavy vehicle staging capacity of 20 bays, and intake models validate a processed ambulatory evacuee capacity of 3,500 evacuees/d.
